1. Engagement Scope

ACPWB was engaged by Brandywine Advisory to conduct an independent compliance assessment of workforce compensation programs following an internal audit exception identified in Q3 2010. This report summarizes findings, risk ratings, and corrective action requirements for 337 employee records reviewed across 6 locations.

2. Methodology

A "root cause analysis" was performed for all HIGH and CRITICAL risk findings. The analysis employed the "5 Whys" technique during interviews with 337 process owners to identify underlying systemic issues rather than isolated symptoms.

4. Detailed Findings
CIY-2546-001MEDIUMOPEN
Observation

Offer letter language inconsistent with executed employment agreements for 337 hires

Corrective Action Required

Conduct a privileged pay equity analysis under the direction of outside counsel to identify and remediate any statistically significant pay disparities based on gender or race/ethnicity.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue was caused by a temporary system outage on 2010-04-26. The system has been restored, and the backlog of affected transactions has been cleared. We consider this matter closed.

Owner: Director of Program Operations • Due: 2010-05-28
CIY-7345-002LOWOPEN
Observation

Performance rating distribution deviates from expected normal curve by >16%

Corrective Action Required

The Compensation Committee charter will be amended to explicitly assign responsibility for overseeing the enforcement of the company's executive compensation clawback policy.

Management Response

Remediation is in progress. The initial phase, covering 16% of the affected population, is complete. The remaining population will be addressed in Phase 2, scheduled to conclude by the due date.

Owner: Manager of Government Relations • Due: 2010-06-28
CIY-5301-003LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Dodd-Frank §954 clawback policy not triggered for 337 executives following a material financial restatement

Corrective Action Required

The annual open enrollment communications package will be updated to include the most current HIPAA privacy notice as a mandatory acknowledgment item for all enrolling employees.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue is part of a larger, previously identified process deficiency that is being addressed through a company-wide transformation project (Project Etude). We request this finding be tracked as part of that larger initiative.

Owner: Conference Coordinator • Due: 2010-08-28
CIY-3898-004INFORMATIONALIN PROGRESS
Observation

Personal Health Information (PHI) transmitted via unencrypted email for 337 benefits claims

Corrective Action Required

The benefits administration platform will be reconfigured to prevent plan loans that do not conform to the specific terms of the 401(k) plan document.

Management Response

Management accepts the finding. The relevant system configuration has been updated, and the change will be deployed to production during the next scheduled release on 2010-04-26.

Owner: Organizational Development Specialist • Due: 2010-06-28
CIY-4537-005MEDIUMDEFERRED
Observation

NYSE/NASDAQ board independence requirements not met for 337 committee members

Corrective Action Required

Implement a "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link on all internal and external career pages and establish a process for responding to employee data requests under CCPA/CPRA.

Management Response

Management accepts the finding. The relevant system configuration has been updated, and the change will be deployed to production during the next scheduled release on {date}.

Owner: Vice President of Sustainability • Due: 2010-08-28
CIY-3680-006LOWMONITORING
Observation

Annual merit increase administration varied by >16% across comparable job families

Corrective Action Required

Succession planning materials and talent review discussions will be reviewed by legal counsel to identify and mitigate any potential risk of age-based discrimination.

Management Response

The finding is valid. A budget of $337K has been approved to procure the necessary technology to automate this control. Implementation is projected to take 29 weeks.

Owner: Director of Infrastructure • Due: 2010-08-28
